dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: Tori enters her home. Ronnie is at his laptop, deep in dev mode.

dialog.speaker: ronnie
dialog.text: Hey honey! How was your day?

dialog.speaker: tori
dialog.text: Pretty good! Hey, can you take a look at my Ronnie-gatchi? I just changed the battery and it's already half-drained. I dropped it earlier, but... I don't think that's the problem.

dialog.speaker: ronnie
dialog.text: Ya sure I can look at it. Why do you call it that anyway?

dialog.speaker: tori
dialog.text: Oh you know because this thing is sooo cute. And what better way to name it than after my man - who's even cuter!

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: She hands him the French Vanilla.

dialog.speaker: tori
dialog.text: Says the guy wearing the TLC hoodie. Again.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: She tugs playfully at his sleeve.

dialog.speaker: ronnie
dialog.text: Well, SOMEONE keeps stealing my BGA hoodie, so this is my replacement.

dialog.speaker: tori
dialog.text: You wear the TLC one anyway! So the BGA one is fair game. Besides, it looks better on me.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: He shakes his head, but there's warmth in his eyes.

dialog.speaker: tori
dialog.text: And you love me anyway, Chicharon.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: She boops his nose playfully. Their nickname - the one she uses when it's just them. Home.

dialog.speaker: tori
dialog.text: I'll get dinner started. Love you!

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: She smiles, sets the buzzing Tamagotchi on his laptop (resting against the keyboard). Leans in, gives him a quick kiss.
